1
What you need to know
Tick each one you know.
Order: fg(x) means f(g(x)). g acts first, then f acts on the result.
Twice: f2(x) means f(f(x)), not [f(x)]2.
Exists only if: fg exists where the output of g lies in the domain of f.
Solving: write the composite as one expression, then solve. Check each answer against the domain.
